Interval.$description: Sets the interval between steps in the `FontSize` scale. Do not use this token directly.

Scale.$description: Used to set overall scaling of `Typography` tokens. Do not use directly. Use `Typography` tokens instead.

NominalScale.$description: Used to normalize font size tokens in Roblox engine, which uses a unique method of determining rendered text size. Do not use directly. Use `Typography` tokens instead.

InverseScale.$description: Inverts the `NominalScale` value, used to re-normalize line-heights for Roblox Engine to get expected results when using `Typography` tokens. Do not use this value directly, use `Typography` tokens instead.

Font.$description: This is a semi-private token used internally to set the font-family for our Typeography tokens. Do not use this token in production contexts; instead use our  `Typography` tokens directly.

Interval.$description: Used to set the standard interval between Size token steps. Do not use directly, use Size, Padding, Margin, or Gap tokens instead.

Scale.$description: Used to set the overall scaling factor for tokens. Do not use directly.

StrokeBase.$description: Used to set the standard thickness of our strokes. Do not use directly, instead use `Stroke` tokens.

Name.$description: This token returns the active theme name as a text string. This token is deprecated and will be removed in upcoming updates to design tokens and Foundation.

isUIBlox.$description: This token returns true when the UIBlox theme is active. This token is deprecated and will be removed in upcoming updates to our tokens and Foundation, as the UIBlox theme has been removed from all production code (UIBlox components are still in use).

isFoundation.$description: This token returns true when the Foundation theme is active. This token is deprecated and will be removed in upcoming updates to our tokens and Foundation, as the Foundation theme is now our default.
